recipes.title: Ginger Garlic Prawn and Veg Stir Fry with Brown Rice
ingredients: 300g large raw king prawns, shelled and deveined (Limit)
200g firm tofu, cubed and patted dry
1/2 head of broccoli, cut into small florets
method: Cook the brown rice according to the packet instructions.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over a high heat. Fry the tofu for 5-6 minutes until golden on all sides. Remove and set aside.
Add the prawns to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes until pink. Remove and set aside with the tofu.
Add the remaining oil, then the ginger, garlic and chilli. Stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add the broccoli and carrots with a splash of water and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add the cabbage and pepper and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes until just tender but still crunchy.
Return the tofu and prawns to the pan with the soy sauce, lime juice and spring onions. Toss for 1 minute until heated through. Season with black pepper.
Serve over the brown rice, topped with toasted pumpkin seeds.
recipes.eat: tofu, broccoli, cabbage, carrots, bell pepper, brown rice, olive oil, pumpkin seeds, ginger, garlic, black pepper
recipes.sourceFile: Type2 - Ginger Garlic Prawn and Veg Stir Fry.txt

recipes.title: Spinach, Pepper and Feta Frittata with Cucumber Salad
ingredients: Small handful of fresh basil, chopped
Salad: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
method: Preheat the grill to medium-high.
Heat the olive oil in a large ovenproof frying pan over a medium heat. Add the pepper and cook for 4 minutes, then add the courgette, spring onions and garlic and cook for 2 minutes more.
Add the spinach a handful at a time and stir until wilted.
Beat the eggs with the turmeric, basil, salt and pepper. Pour into the pan and gently move the veg so it is evenly spread.
Scatter over the feta and cook on the hob for 5-6 minutes until the base is set.
Put the pan under the grill for 3-5 minutes until the top is set and lightly golden.
While it cooks, toss the cucumber and tomatoes with the oil, vinegar, oregano and a pinch of salt.
Cut the frittata into wedges and serve with the salad.
recipes.eat: eggs, spinach, bell pepper, courgette, cucumber, tomatoes, olive oil, garlic, turmeric, basil, oregano
recipes.sourceFile: Type2 - Spinach Pepper and Feta Frittata.txt

recipes.title: Turkey and Lentil Chilli with Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 x 400g tin kidney beans, drained and rinsed
method: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over a medium heat. Add the onion, carrots and pepper and cook for 6-8 minutes until softened.
Add the garlic and turkey mince. Cook, breaking up the mince, until browned all over.
Stir in the cumin, paprika, chilli flakes and cinnamon and cook for 1 minute.

Add the lentils, tomatoes and stock. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils are soft and the chilli has thickened. Add a splash of water if it gets too thick.
Meanwhile, cook the brown rice according to the packet instructions (usually 25-30 minutes).
Stir the kidney beans into the chilli for the last 5 minutes and season to taste.
Serve the chilli over the rice with a small sprinkle of Cheddar.
recipes.eat: turkey, lentils, beans, tomatoes, bell pepper, carrots, brown rice, olive oil, garlic, cinnamon
recipes.sourceFile: Type2 - Turkey and Lentil Chilli with Brown Rice.txt

recipes.title: Spiced Chicken and Chickpea Tray Bake
ingredients: 4 skinless chicken breasts, about 130g each, cut into large chunks
1 x 400g tin chickpeas, drained and rinsed
2 bell peppers (mixed colours), cut into chunks
1 medium sweet potato, cut into 2cm cubes (Limit)
method: Preheat the oven to 200C (180C fan).
Mix the olive oil, turmeric, cinnamon, cumin, garlic, ginger, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the chicken, chickpeas, peppers, courgettes, onion and sweet potato. Toss well to coat everything.
Spread over one large or two medium trays in a single layer. Roast for 20 minutes.
Add the cherry tomatoes, give everything a turn and roast for a further 12-15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sweet potato is tender.
Stir the lemon juice and a pinch of salt into the yoghurt.
Serve the tray bake with a spoonful of the lemon yoghurt on top.
recipes.eat: skinless chicken, chickpeas, bell peppers, courgette (zucchini), tomatoes, Greek yoghurt, olive oil, turmeric, cinnamon, garlic, ginger
recipes.sourceFile: Type2 - Spiced Chicken and Chickpea Tray Bake.txt

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Salmon with Broccoli and Quinoa
ingredients: 1 large head of broccoli, cut into florets
Small handful of fresh basil, torn
method: Preheat the oven to 200C (180C fan).
Put the quinoa in a pan with 450ml water and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, cover and simmer for 15 minutes until the water is absorbed. Take off the heat and leave covered.
Toss the broccoli and pepper with 1 tbsp olive oil, half the garlic, salt and pepper. Spread on a large baking tray and roast for 10 minutes.
Mix the remaining oil and garlic with the lemon zest, half the lemon juice and the oregano. Brush over the salmon and season.
Push the veg to the sides of the tray, add the salmon and roast for 12-15 minutes until the fish flakes easily.
Stir the butter, remaining lemon juice and basil through the quinoa.
Serve the salmon on the quinoa with the roasted veg alongside.
recipes.eat: salmon, quinoa, broccoli, bell pepper, olive oil, garlic, oregano, basil, black pepper
recipes.sourceFile: Type2 - Lemon Herb Salmon with Broccoli and Quinoa.txt

recipes.title: Saffron Crusted Shrimp and Pesto Pasta
ingredients: Pesto (fresh basil leaves, garlic powder, salt, olive oil)
method: Prepare the pesto: in a food processor, combine basil leaves, garlic powder, salt and 1/4 cup (60g) of olive oil. Process until smooth. Set aside.
Cook the pasta: bring a large pot of salted water to the boil and cook the pasta until al dente. Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining.
Prepare the shrimp: heat 1 tbsp (15g) olive oil in a separate pan over medium-high heat. Cook the shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side until pink and cooked through. Set aside.
Make the saffron crust: mix saffron threads (soaked in hot water) with 1 tsp (5g) olive oil. Brush onto the shrimp, then coat with a pinch of Parmesan (if using).
Combine pasta and pesto: in a large bowl, toss cooked pasta, pesto and reserved pasta water until well coated.
Assemble: add the shrimp and chopped sun-dried tomatoes and toss together.
Serve immediately, topped with extra Parmesan if desired.
recipes.notes: Original has no quantities for the main ingredients.
recipes.sourceFile: Navi's - Saffron Crusted Shrimp and Pesto Pasta

recipes.title: Sticky Honey and Smoked Paprika Chicken
ingredients: 1-3 tbsp Calabrian chilli paste from a jar, or jarred chopped chillies, to taste
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
method: Place the chicken wings in a colander, mix in 1 tsp salt and let the skin dry out for 15 minutes while you get everything else ready.
To make the marinade, pour the honey into a large bowl and add the chilli paste or chopped chillies, vinegar, tomato purée and oil. Whisk, then set aside.
Preheat the air fryer to 190C for 3 minutes.
In another large bowl, mix the garlic powder, flour, paprika and 1/2 tsp pepper. Add the wings and toss to coat evenly. Pour about three-quarters of the honey marinade over and mix well.
Transfer to the air fryer basket and cook for 10 minutes. Turn the wings and cook for a further 8 minutes until sticky and cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix the 'Nduja with the remaining marinade. Drizzle over the wings and cook for a final 1-2 minutes to melt.
Plate up, dot with the mascarpone or Dolcelatte and serve.
